name: Spotify & YouTube Downloader
author: mdKNEET
description: Paste a Spotify or YouTube link into the Omarchy bar and download it as a local file via spotDL or yt-dlp, with a queue for multiple simultaneous downloads.

barWidget.description: Download Spotify tracks, albums, and playlists with spotDL and YouTube videos and playlists with yt-dlp. Queue several downloads at once and pick the destination folder.

schema.label: Download folder
schema.description: Where downloaded tracks are saved: a local folder or a network share (smb://server/share/folder).

schema.label: Save YouTube links as
schema.description: audio uses the audio format above; video saves an mp4 of at most 1080p.
